description: This file implements the HttpEncoder class functions for serializing various HTTP/QUIC frames, including data, headers, settings, goaway, priority update, accept-ch, greasing, web transport stream, and metadata frames within the quic namespace.

methods.name: WriteFrameHeader
methods.description: Helper function to write frame header with type and length using QuicDataWriter.

methods.name: GetTotalLength
methods.description: Calculates total length of a frame including type and payload length fields.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::GetDataFrameHeaderLength
methods.description: Returns length of data frame header based on payload length.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeDataFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes data frame header into a QuicheBuffer.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeHeadersFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes headers frame header into a string.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeSettingsFrame
methods.description: Serializes settings frame with provided settings into a string.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeGoAwayFrame
methods.description: Serializes a goaway frame with given ID into a string.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializePriorityUpdateFrame
methods.description: Serializes a priority update frame into a string.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeAcceptChFrame
methods.description: Serializes an accept-ch frame with entries into a string.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeGreasingFrame
methods.description: Serializes a greasing frame with optional random content.

methods.name: HttpEncoder::SerializeWebTransportStreamFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebTransport stream frame header with session ID.
